title: James Patterson 3rd Degree Hardcover Womens Murder Club Andrew Gross
conditionDescription: Pre-owned hardcover with dust jacket. Normal shelf wear; a prior retailer price sticker is on the jacket. Pages clean and unmarked as far as inspected. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
James Patterson and Andrew Gross - 3rd Degree, a Women's Murder Club thriller (Little, Brown). Hardcover with dust jacket.

Detective Lindsay Boxer is jogging along a San Francisco street when a fiery explosion rips through the neighborhood. Three people are found dead, an infant cannot be found, and a mysterious message at the scene leaves Lindsay and the San Francisco Police Department baffled.

Photographed front, spine, back and both jacket flaps.
